s01-01-7abf4d.wav.text: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

s01-02-b31483.wav.text: The earth was formless and empty, and darkness covered the deep.

s02-01-a749d8.wav.text: On the first day, there was light, separated from the darkness.

s02-02-19788d.wav.text: On the second, the sky, dividing the waters.

s02-03-937ebf.wav.text: On the third, dry land, seas and plants.

s02-04-efa61d.wav.text: On the fourth, the sun, the moon and the stars.

s02-05-f6ac68.wav.text: On the fifth, creatures filled the seas and birds filled the sky.

s02-06-6b4406.wav.text: And on the sixth, animals walked the land.

s03-01-66fdde.wav.text: The climax of creation was humanity.

s03-02-d1f1c8.wav.text: God made human beings, male and female, in his own image.

s03-03-413c22.wav.text: He blessed them, and gave them charge over the earth.

s03-04-f69e93.wav.text: Then he looked at everything he had made, and it was very good.

s03-05-78e679.wav.text: On the seventh day, God rested, and he made that day holy.

s04-02-5c5050.wav.text: The Lord God formed the man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life.

s04-03-9c7415.wav.text: He placed him in a garden in Eden, to work it and take care of it.

s05-01-a94c63.wav.text: In the middle of the garden stood two trees: the tree of life, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

s05-02-2e72f3.wav.text: The man could eat freely from any tree except the second one.

s05-03-f85af2.wav.text: If he ate from that tree, God warned, he would certainly die.

s06-02-f86f84.wav.text: It is not good for the man to be alone.

s06-03-5dc44f.wav.text: He brought the animals to the man to be named, but not one was a suitable helper.

s06-04-9bee54.wav.text: So God put the man into a deep sleep, took one of his ribs, and made a woman.

s06-05-94b220.wav.text: When the man saw her, he said she was bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh.

s06-06-748764.wav.text: The two became one flesh, naked and without shame.

s07-01-6d269c.wav.text: Then came the serpent, craftier than any other wild animal.

s07-02-5f997e.wav.text: It asked the woman a question. Did God really say?

s07-03-dda11c.wav.text: She explained God's command, adding that they must not even touch the fruit.

s07-04-e085ea.wav.text: And the serpent contradicted God directly.

s07-06-216b6d.wav.text: Eat it, the serpent claimed, and your eyes will be opened.

s07-07-51f29f.wav.text: You will be like God, knowing good and evil.

s08-01-221a4c.wav.text: The woman saw that the fruit looked good, and that it was desirable for gaining wisdom.

s08-03-e64a2a.wav.text: She gave some to her husband, who was with her, and he ate too.

s08-04-66ebf6.wav.text: Their eyes were opened, just as promised.

s08-05-eea48a.wav.text: But all they discovered was their nakedness and their shame.

s08-06-657c0e.wav.text: So they sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves.

s09-01-d5a95e.wav.text: Then they heard the Lord God walking in the garden, in the cool of the day, and they hid among the trees.

s09-02-bf8a9e.wav.text: God called out. Where are you?

s09-03-4d9e4c.wav.text: The man admitted that he had hidden in fear.

s09-05-9726ac.wav.text: He pointed to the woman, and to God for giving her to him.

s10-01-e79500.wav.text: The serpent was cursed to crawl on its belly.

s10-02-c7a49f.wav.text: God put hostility between it and the woman, and between their offspring.

s10-03-e5112c.wav.text: He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.

s10-04-ac71d0.wav.text: Christians have long read this as the first hint of a Savior.

s10-05-e4e65e.wav.text: The woman would have greatly increased pain in childbearing, and conflict in her marriage.

s10-06-08b26c.wav.text: The man would work cursed ground through painful toil, among thorns and thistles, until death.

s10-07-00da93.wav.text: For dust you are and to dust you will return.

s11-01-21e1c3.wav.text: Adam named his wife Eve, because she would become the mother of all the living.

s11-02-b85238.wav.text: And in an act of mercy, God made garments of skin and clothed them.

s11-03-cf028d.wav.text: Then he banished them from Eden, so they would not eat from the tree of life and live forever.

s11-04-82aef4.wav.text: On the east side of the garden, he placed cherubim and a flaming sword, to guard the way back to that tree.
